channel_selection_source.paper: Leone et al., Enabling SNN-Based Near-MEA Neural Decoding with Channel Selection, DATE 2025

ranking.source: chronological first 50% of training entries only
ranking.feature: 1 ms binary GT MUA; mean is proportional to firing rate
ranking.axis_reduction_warning: The paper does not specify how multiple behavioral-variable correlations are collapsed; RMS magnitude is a documented reproduction assumption.
ranking.nested_subsets: top32 is a subset of top64 for the same session ranking
ranking.leakage_control: validation and test entries are excluded from ranking

shared_baseline_preprocessing.task_start: recording start, then every third reach boundary -32 ms
shared_baseline_preprocessing.test: continuous from first held-out task through recording end

progress_logging.percent_basis: maximum 100 epochs; early stopping may finish sooner
